# HeyMate

> Free, MIT-licensed AI companion for macOS 14.2 and later. Screen guidance, approved computer control, specialist mates, and routines. Bring your own AI; provider limits and optional service fees apply.

HeyMate runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Screen guidance needs a vision-capable provider. Product facts below include privacy, background work, installation, and signing caveats. Downloads are not active-user counts.

## Product and setup

- [Product facts](https://sayheymate.com/index.md): Capabilities, system requirements, provider support, privacy, storage, and installation caveats.
- [Website](https://sayheymate.com/): Product overview and real app recordings.
- [Getting started](https://sayheymate.com/how-to-use-heymate): Installation, provider sign-in, and first task.
- [Permissions](https://sayheymate.com/permissions): macOS permissions and computer control.
- [Privacy](https://sayheymate.com/privacy): Local data, provider processing, and analytics.

- [Connect Claude or Codex](https://sayheymate.com/connect-claude-codex.md): Provider sign-in, prerequisites, cost, and troubleshooting.
- [Screen guidance walkthrough](https://sayheymate.com/screen-guidance.md): Permissions, example prompts, control choices, and privacy.

- [Source code](https://github.com/UmarSiddiqui/heymate): Public source repository.
